The '''Aggressor-series battle droid''' was a cheap [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] manufactured by [[Farrfin Droidworks]]. The droids were produced in large numbers despite Imperial restrictions on the combat models. [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]], its creators, designed it in response to increasing number of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
[[File:Aggressor_IX-6_LON-29.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Aggressor-series battle droid, alongside [[IX-6 heavy combat droid]] and [[LON-29 battle droid commander]]]]

The Aggressor-series battle droid was unusual in that it didn't come with any ranged weapons, but used a [[dire vibroblade]] as its primary weapon. Its dedication to melee combat made them an unexpected, unorthodox and unusual opponent in a fight. While the simplistic combat programming prevented the droids from being much of a threat to the Sith, Farrfin Droidworks planned on activating a hidden update in droids' programming, which would replace their primitive combat programming with a more sophisticated one, making the droids a significant and widespread threat to the [[One Sith|Sith]].<ref name="LECG" />

[[Darth Krayt]] used several Aggressor-series battle droids as training droids for his Sith underlings.<ref name="LECG" />
